before.gpr_evidence_basis: Identity review 2026-10-19: the former GPR gene YALI1D17462g (NCBI Gene 2910235, XP_502815.3, 384 aa) carries only A1 aspartic peptidase signatures (Pfam PF00026, PROSITE PS00141 at both active-site motifs) and no argininosuccinate synthase signature, and no W29 gene is annotated for argininosuccinate synthase.
before.gpr_evidence_label: No gene assigned: the W29 argininosuccinate synthase locus is unannotated; not experimentally confirmed
before.r153_authorization: 2026-09-15: 用户先要求将YALI1D17462g补充进R153并接入管线，随后明确要求去除YALIUNK2。Use YALI1D17462g alone and remove the placeholder gene entry only if no other reaction associations remain.
before.r153_gene_function: YALI1D17462g; native gene symbol unverified; AOW04049.1 / A0A1D8NEI7, 384 aa; A1-family aspartyl endopeptidase function candidate based on sequence and AlphaFold prediction; not experimentally verified as argininosuccinate synthase.
before.r153_placeholder_identity: Removed YALIUNK2 had no established name or molecular identity and carried a model-only synthase role. Its removal does not establish that it was biologically identical to YALI1D17462g.
before.r153_model_interpretation: Gene-less since R153-GPR-UNASSIGNED-20261019: no single-gene knockout disables R153, so the model makes no gene-level prediction for argininosuccinate synthase. This reflects a missing W29 gene model, not evidence that the step needs no enzyme.
before.r153_conflicting_evidence: 2026-09-11 fixed-panel sequence and structural comparisons strongly support A1 aspartyl peptidase for YALI1D17462g. Query-normalized TM: 0.74282 to experimental peptidase 1DPJ versus 0.26708/0.27714 to synthases 2NZ2/1K97. These results oppose the assigned synthase function; they are not supporting synthase evidence.
before.r153_alphafold_provenance: Existing sequence-identical AlphaFold prediction AF-A0A1D8NEI7-F1, Monomer v2.0 pipeline, file v6; target sequence SHA256 bf9ffec20d0feb2f68a19fa10b102240dc138035b1997fa81b1c159fe0c192b3. Reused 2026-09-11; no new prediction or structural comparison in this assignment.
before.r153_scope_limits: R153 GPR/evidence notes and the unreferenced YALIUNK2 gene entry only. R2176, reaction chemistry, bounds, compartments and other GPRs unchanged. W29 terminal synthase coding identity remains unresolved; no phenotype improvement or native synthase function established.
before.r153_superseded_assignment: The earlier 2026-09-15 OR assignment YALIUNK2 or YALI1D17462g is superseded by the explicit remove-YALIUNK2 instruction. Historical OR output and curation bytes are preserved.
before.reaction_merge_capacity: User-authorized single [-1000,1000] bound; former summed interval [-2000,2000]. Not a globally equivalent feasible set.
before.reaction_merge_evidence: Exact same stoichiometry, compartments, bounds and GPR in fixed input; existing conflicting GPR function evidence remains unconfirmed.
before.reaction_merge_supersedes: Earlier R153 notes describing preserved R2176 apply to the pre-merge build. R2176 is now merged into R153; no new gene-function validation.
before.r153_gpr_revision_authorization: 2026-10-19: user approved option A of model/reports/r153_ass_gpr_20261019/REPORT.md (gene-less R153 through a guarded post-merge step and opt-in flag, YALI1D17462g kept unlinked).
before.r153_gpr_revision_basis: KEGG yli:90949668 / YALI2_D00589g (argininosuccinate synthase) is a Yarrowia lipolytica DSM 3286 gene (KEGG T01033, RefSeq GCF_014490615.1); its NCBI Gene record is discontinued and its RefSeq chromosome NC_089381.1 is suppressed. The current W29 RefSeq (NC_090773.1) has no YALI1 counterpart. Verified online 2026-10-19.
before.r153_w29_locus: NC_090773.1 / CP017556.1 3604630-3609948, between YALI1_D36035g and YALI1_D36100g, carries no annotated feature. Argininosuccinate synthase homology there (3606992-3608481) splits across reading frames -3 and -1 (recorded 2026-09-11). Whether this is an assembly error, a strain variant or a pseudogene is unresolved.
before.r153_identity_candidate: One identical 413-aa argininosuccinate synthase sequence in 11 Y. lipolytica strains, for example PO1f KAE8172175.1 (BKA90DRAFT_137900) and DSM 3286 QNP98148.1 (CDD cd01999, HAMAP MF_00005, TIGR00032). Not a W29 gene ID and not assigned to the GPR.
before.r153_screen_coverage: No gene at the W29 argininosuccinate synthase locus is in the Cas9, Cas12a or Patterson Tn-seq gene sets, so the step has no experimental essentiality label.
before.r153_unlinked_gene: YALI1D17462g (A1 aspartic peptidase candidate by automatic annotation) is kept in the model with no reactions.
before.r153_gpr_revision_supersedes: Supersedes the GPR and current-status notes of R153-USER-SINGLE-GPR-20260915 (GPR YALI1D17462g); the previous note values are recorded in model/curation/gpr/r153_gpr_revision.json.
